items.title: The Role of Technology in Cultural and Societal Change (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of The Role of Technology in Cultural and Societal Change (PDF 136-137, printed 132-133).

blocks.text: Technology badalti hai ke log kaise baat karte, kaam karte aur maloomat hasil karte hain. Social media, digital learning aur online services saqafat aur rozmarra zindagi par asar dalti hain. Technology taleem, sehat aur karobar ki karkardagi behtar kar sakti hai. Lekin yeh challenges bhi paida kar sakti hai, jaise digital divide (jin ke paas technology hai aur jin ke paas nahi, un ke darmiyan farq) ya privacy ka khatam hona. In samaji asraat ko samajhna muashre mein technology ke soch samajh kar aur zimmedarana istemal ki himmat afzai karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Technology se muashre ko do fawaid aur do challenges likhein jo kitab batati hai.
blocks.explanation: Fawaid: taleem, sehat aur karobar ki efficiency behtar. Challenges: digital divide (jin ke paas technology hai aur jin ke paas nahi un ka farq) aur privacy ka khatma.

blocks.prompt: Poore section 9.5 ka jaiza: Talib-e-ilm na-maloom website se paisay wali kitab ka PDF download kar ke class group mein share karta hai. Is se kaun se akhlaqi, qanooni aur security masail paida hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Akhlaqi aur qanooni: ijazat ke baghair copy aur share kar ke publisher ki intellectual property aur copyright torta hai. Security: na-maloom sites ki files mein malware ho sakta hai jo kholne wale har shakhs tak phail jaye. Sahi amal sarkari ya library nuskha use karna hai.

items: Technology communication, kaam aur maloomat tak rasai badalti hai.
Fawaid ke saath digital divide aur privacy loss jaise challenges.
